assets.title: Home: what to do next
assets.caption: Home summarises the product's evidence and names the single next step.
assets.altText: Viable Home for the fictional product Ledgerly: a one-line product description, counts for product truth revision, two audience hypotheses, three reviewed evidence items and one open action, and a 'What should I do now?' panel recommending a named review of a competitor signal, with an Open signal button.

assets.title: Audience comparison
assets.caption: Two audience hypotheses are compared dimension by dimension, each rating with its evidence and confidence.
assets.altText: Candidate comparison table for two audiences, Independent design studios (3-15 people) and Solo freelance creatives. Each row (problem intensity, urgency, product fit, time to value, reachable access, available proof) shows a rating out of 4, the evidence behind it and a confidence level. A note reads: No unexplained composite score is calculated.
assets.limitations: Seed state, Product & audience view scrolled to the comparison.

assets.title: Named review of market evidence
assets.caption: An imported signal stays a suggestion until a named person accepts or dismisses it.
assets.altText: Signals inbox with two suggested signals. On the competitor announcement card a Named human review panel is open: it repeats the signal's summary, source, retrieval date, confidence and limitations, has the reviewer name Morgan Reyes entered, and offers Accept evidence or Dismiss evidence.
assets.limitations: Review panel opened through the UI; the decision was not submitted for this frame. The evidence drawer text includes an empty 'Facts: {}' field.

assets.title: Review feedback where the correction happens
assets.caption: Reviewer decisions and notes appear on the content itself, with the correction form ready.
assets.altText: Studio channel variants. The LinkedIn variant is marked Approved, with the note 'Approved by Sam Okafor: Matches the canonical asset and states private beta.' The Website variant is marked Changes requested, with Sam Okafor's note that 'zero manual entry' and 'reconciles everything' are not supported by the approved claim, and the correction form open below.
assets.limitations: Seed state; the review decisions shown are synthetic seed records.

assets.title: Manual activation, recorded by a person
assets.caption: Approved work is scheduled and posted by hand; the delivery shown is a synthetic, human-recorded entry.
assets.altText: Calendar records. The entry 'LinkedIn launch post: month-end close' shows Schedule: scheduled and Activation: delivered, owner Morgan Reyes, source the approved campaign variant, reviewed by Sam Okafor. Below it a follow-up entry, and a Manual activation packages section titled Export without claiming delivery.
assets.limitations: The delivery outcome was recorded through the Calendar form as human_recorded with the synthetic publication id 'synthetic-demo-post-1'. No provider confirmation exists.
